alerts.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued September 17 at 1:50PM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
alerts.desc:
A Marine Weather Statement has been issued for the following areas...
Tidal Potomac from Indian Head to Cobb Island MD...
Tidal Potomac from Key Bridge to Indian Head MD...

At 149 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated a front, capable of producing
wind gusts of 20 to 25 knots. This gust front was located along a
line extending from 13 nm west of Annapolis to near Tidal Basin to 7
nm northwest of Alexandria, moving south at 20 knots.
